hard_failures.statement: The APPLIED arm is a moving target inside the round. The adjudication binds research_map/class_separation.py#a8c04fc3 and was filed 01:03:24; the canonical path was written to e36b0d64 at 01:06:12 (live hard 19->16, claims 14->12, corpus-C spec 3/10->4/10) and rolled back to a8c04fc3 at 01:08:14, while the round's detector-write freeze was open. No event naming e36b0d64 or recording the write/rollback was found in events.jsonl or the outboxes at measurement time. The adjudication's own falsifier ('the cited-hash verification fails') is therefore triggered for the live canonical file, and 'one independent review at the frozen hashes' cannot certify the bytes the decision will govern.
hard_failures.needed: Controller records the 01:06:12 write and 01:08:14 rollback as protocol events with pre/post sha256 and authority, names the detector-of-record, then re-freezes; if e36b0d64 is adopted, re-run the census at those bytes (this review's live section is the measurement) and re-issue the review request at the new hash.

findings.statement: Every declared census number reproduces exactly at the pinned hashes on an independently written runner: all four arms' corpus-A 17/0/10/0 PASS, corpus-C per-arm rates (APPLIED 4/6,3/10; PRE 4/6,1/10; STAGED 5/6,1/10; PROSEFIX 4/6,10/10), corpus-D fixture census (APPLIED 30/1/6/2, PRE 31/0/6/2, STAGED 31/0/6/2, PROSEFIX 20/11/2/6) and cue-FN (1 HIGH / 0 / 0 / 11 with 10 HIGH), live hard (19/24/25/1 on 14/16/16/1 claims). 0 mismatches, 7/7 controls pass.

The residual live count of 19 is 19/19 metalinguistic on the reviewer's independent read (no genuine first-order C0/C2 unity assertion); the adjudication's decision not to retire claims this round is therefore correct, and the 2 unlabeled DETECTOR_SELF claims (327,336) were honestly reported rather than silently counted FP.

Decision (c) is robust in kind at the transient e36b0d64 bytes: no arm meets the adoption bar there either (corpus-A PASS, APPLIED spec 4/10, 1 HIGH cue-induced FN; the hunk only silences one corpus-C mention M7 and three meta findings). The APPLIED column of the census is nonetheless stale for e36b0d64.

The A04 clause-scoped FN ('The detector flagged this once; C0 and C2 are one class.') survives both a8c04fc3 and e36b0d64; the directive's acceptance criterion ('any genuine class-merge fixture is missed') is unmet by both bytes, so the detector-fix task cannot be marked complete on either.

Corpus C is adjudicator-authored; its 16 fixture strings are author-declared data. The per-row outcomes are reproduced and the M7 row is exactly the row the e36b0d64 hunk changes, so the corpus is internally coherent; provenance of the strings remains a residual limitation of the round, not a defect found here.
